messages:
Maria G: Hey — quick question. I opened a tiny cleanup PR that crossed two dirs and I'm not sure who should sign off before merge: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/1543
It touches runtime/kv_cache.py and eng-platform/telemetry/formatters.py. CODEOWNERS maps runtime/ -> @team-runtime, telemetry/ -> @team-telemetry, but there's no single owner for the combined change. I don't want to guess and accidentally bypass the right reviewer. Anyone able to advise who can approve here?

Samir: If it's just a docs/logging tweak and no behavior change, I can rubber-stamp it. If there's any KV cache logic touched, that needs runtime sign-off. Can you paste the diff or call out exact changes?

Devin: FWIW our policy is: behavioral changes require the primary code owner for the area that could regress production to approve. For cross-area docs/chore changes we use a single owner to speed it up (usually the owner of the dir with the code change). We also have a fallback group @eng-platform/approvers for small cross-cutting chores.

Alice: I can take a look tomorrow AM. If Maria confirms no KV cache semantics were changed (only logging string + tests), Samir is fine to approve. If any logic in kv_cache.py changed, tag me — that's a runtime semantics thing.

runtime-bot: CODEOWNERS lookup:
- runtime/ -> @team-runtime (owners: Alice, Rahul)
- eng-platform/telemetry/ -> @team-telemetry (owners: Priya, Samir)
Fallback approvers group: @eng-platform/approvers
Use `/request-approver @eng-platform/approvers` to request a proxy sign-off when multiple owners block merge.

Maria G: Thanks — pushed a small follow-up that removes the accidental kv_cache edit and leaves only a logging change + test name fix. Diff excerpt:
```diff
-    logger.debug(f"kv miss for key={key}, src={src}")
+    logger.debug("kv miss: %s", key)
```
Pinging @Samir for quick approve since it's small and non-behavioral.

Samir: Reviewed the diff — looks fine to me. Approving now. :thumbsup: Will merge in ~30m if no objections.

Alice: I skimmed it — LGTM from me as well (thanks for the cleanup). :shipit:

Maria G: Awesome, thanks everyone!
